hero.title: We are Espeletia Trips
hero.description: We were founded in Murillo, Tolima, with the purpose of sharing the beauty of our region in a responsible, authentic, and sustainable way, connecting people with unforgettable experiences in the heart of the páramo.

story.title: Passion for our land
story.description: We are a local team that knows, loves, and protects every corner of Murillo. We work alongside local communities to offer tours that generate a positive impact, promote conservation, and strengthen the regional economy.

one.title: Sustainability
one.description: We care for the páramo and promote responsible practices on every tour.

two.title: Community
two.description: We work hand in hand with local residents and generate shared benefits.

three.title: Safety
three.description: We prioritize your well-being with certified guides and safe routes.

four.title: Authenticity
four.description: We offer real, cultural, and transformative experiences.

cta.title: Travel with purpose
cta.description: More than a destination, we invite you to be part of the conservation of a unique ecosystem and the stories that make it special.
